messages:
sara-peopleops: FYI team 1: we've updated the Performance Cycle timeline to shift calibration week earlier by one week to avoid overlap with Q4 audits. Please review the change and ACK by 2026-07-10. Diff: https://internal.redwood/handbook/performance/changes/1769009000

leah.peopleops: TL;DR: calibration moved from 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-03. Managers need to submit calibration-ready notes by 2026-07-27. Also launching a 20-min manager calibration micro-training required for anyone participating in calibration.

ryan-peopleops: Micro-training link: https://training.redwood/micro/calibration-2026. Due date for managers: 2026-07-24. Compliance bot will nudge weekly.

alex-recruiting: Quick coordination Q: we have two candidates with tentative start dates Aug 11. Will they be included in calibration if they start after calibration? Need to know for offer language.

talia-hr: New hires >30 days prior to calibration are included for performance conversation context; hires starting after calibration are excluded from current cycle. For offers, use the standard probation language.

aleax-recruiting: (typo) sorry meant @alex-recruiting. Got it. I'll ensure offers don't promise immediate review during this cycle.

onboarding-bot: Note: New hires starting between 2026-07-01 and 2026-08-15 will receive "Welcome + Performance Overview" materials automatically. Link: https://training.redwood/assign/welcome-performance.

leah.peopleops: Contractors: contractors are excluded from calibration but contractors who touch PII must complete the Data Handling addendum and the contractor-specific micro-course. Recruiting please flag such contractors in the tracker.

alex-recruiting: Will add flags. Also updating `templates/offer-letter.md` to avoid implying eligibility for this cycle. PR forthcoming.

compliance-bot: Reminder: "Manager Calibration 2026" micro-training assigned to managers. Due 2026-07-24. Weekly digest every Mon. Completion report will be sent to managers on 2026-07-25.

sara-peopleops: Managers 1: please confirm on this thread once you've added the training to your team checklist and notified direct reports of any calibration-impacting leaves. I'll pull the ack + completion report next Monday and follow up with teams below 90% completion.

ryan-peopleops: I'll run a leave-overlap report and post in the HR drive. If any managers have team members on leave from 2026-07-20 to 2026-08-05 please DM me names.

alex-recruiting: Acked 1 I've updated onboarding flow and will open PR for the offer templates.

leah.peopleops: Thanks all 1 office hours tomorrow 9:30am PT if you want to walk through the timeline and the micro-training. Slides will be posted in #people-ops-resources after."
